identitySignals: Name matches: the Northern Alameda Adult Education Collective (NAAEC) is a regional adult education consortium based in Oakland, CA (naaec.org; CAEP consortium directory)
The consortium's 2023-24 CAEP planning document (CFAD) says it operates as a JPA (joint powers authority), matching the 'Joint Power Authority' in the agenda name
California Adult Education Program directory lists Oakland Unified as a member of the consortium, matching an OUSD data-sharing MOU presented by the Chief Academic Officer
naaec.org lists OUSD's Oakland Adult and Career Education program among its member programs
research.notes: No EIN, CA entity number or SAM UEI found; no general email published. Phone is the toll-free number shown on the NAAEC contact page, which lists the Peralta CCD District Office address.

profile.summary: A regional consortium of adult schools, community colleges, school districts and the county office of education in northern Alameda County. It coordinates adult education services such as English as a Second Language, basic literacy, high school diploma or equivalency, and career training. It operates as a joint powers authority, with Peralta Community College District as its fiscal agent.
